prevalence_band.why_it_is_not_disqualifying: The band was calibrated under the frozen 21-sweep / 10.46 s carve. Applied to the authorized ~2.1 s window it also rejects KITTI-360, on vertical coverage (21 of 32 z-levels against a floor of 30). Each corpus fails a different band and the corpus the bands were calibrated from is one of them.
prevalence_band.cause: Scene content. LiDAR sparsity is falsified as the cause: removing 85 % of KITTI-360's returns leaves it in band (prevalence elasticity to point count ~0.1).

anchors.note: the anchor count is NOT the independent count
